instruction.text: Will and Monika are arguing over who is taller. Will says that he is taller because his height is 140 `centimetres` and Monika is only 60 `inches` tall. Convert Monika’s height into centimetres to work out who is taller.

instruction.text: Fernando is on a road trip. Today he is supposed to drive 260 `miles`. He says that he is halfway there because he has already driven 160 `kilometres`. Convert the distance he has driven today into miles to work out whether he is correct.
instruction.sound: Fernando is on a road trip. Today he is supposed to drive 260 miles. He says that he is halfway there because he has already driven 160 kilometres. Convert the distance he has driven today into miles to work out whether he is correct.

instruction.text: How much further does he have to drive today to complete half of his journey?

atoms.a: First, calculate half of the total distance he wants to cover today.
Next, subtract the distance he has already covered from the halfway point.

instruction.text: Matteo is painting a room in his house. He has already used a 6 `litre` bucket and bought a new 4 `pint` bucket. Work out the total amount of paint he uses in pints.
instruction.sound: Matteo is painting a room in his house. He has already used a 6 litre bucket and bought a new 4 pint bucket. Work out the total amount of paint he uses in pints.

atoms.a: First, convert the volume of the first bucket of paint into pints.
Next, add together the volume of the two buckets.

instruction.text: Matteo uses a ladder to paint the tops of the walls and the ceiling. The maximum weight you can be to use the ladder is 120 `kilograms`. Matteo weighs 220 `pounds`. He thinks that he can safely use the ladder. Convert his weight into kilograms to work out whether he is correct.
